next.reason: 1985: 'If the literal phrase is specified, the alphabet-name may not be referenced in a CODE-SET clause'; 2023: 'If a character code set is being specified, the implementor defines the ordinal number within the character code set'. 2023 lets a literal-phrase alphabet define a coded character set (Table 6: Y), so CODE-SET may use it. STANDARD-2 may also be the IRV or a national version, as the implementor specifies.
